This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [http://www.farawaypress.com/ Faraway Press: The Online Home of John Jackson Miller].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{Faraway|subdomain=|url=|text=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

All fields need to be explicitly assigned to; otherwise, use of the "=" symbol in the URLs messes up the template.

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} The URL of the page, minus <code><nowiki>http://www.farawaypress.com/</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|text}} The formatted text to display.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|subdomain}} If the URL is a subdomain of farawaypress.com, the subdomain can be specified. Default is <code><nowiki>www</nowiki></code> if left blank.
*{{Para|nolive}} When the original online content is no longer available, add "<code>|nolive=1</code>".

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

===Example(s)===
<code><nowiki>{{Faraway|url=fiction/books/swanewdawn.html|text=''Star Wars: A New Dawn''|archivedate=20161019211529}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Faraway|url=fiction/books/swanewdawn.html|text=''Star Wars: A New Dawn''|archivedate=20161019211529}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{Faraway|url=blog/2010/02/16/kotor-countdown-2-just-asked-questions|text=KOTOR Countdown #2: Just-Asked-Questions, The Finale!|archivedate=20200805132619}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Faraway|url=blog/2010/02/16/kotor-countdown-2-just-asked-questions|text=KOTOR Countdown #2: Just-Asked-Questions, The Finale!|archivedate=20200805132619}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{Faraway|url=fiction/books/swanewdawn.html|text=''Star Wars: A New Dawn''|archivedate=20161019211529}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Faraway|url=fiction/books/swanewdawn.html|text=''Star Wars: A New Dawn''|archivedate=20161019211529}}
